snippet.title: HYPERyuki | Nintendo Switch 2 | Console Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
🏂 Hit the slopes. Break the rules. Join the Syndicate.

Fresh off Nintendo's Indie World Showcase, HYPERyuki: Snowboard Syndicate is carving its way onto Nintendo Switch 2!

Get ready for high-speed snowboarding, massive tricks, and rebellious energy as you shred your way through the mountain and make your mark with the Syndicate.

❄️ Coming to Nintendo Switch 2, PC (Steam), PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S.

🎮 Stay tuned for more Nintendo Switch 2 updates, gameplay, and release details!

🔥 Who are you riding with? Drop it in the comments!

Subscribe to Acclaim for the latest trailers, announcements, and reveals.
